assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: blog article photography for landscape covers and inline editorial images.
Style/medium: photorealistic premium beauty still-life photography with real metal, textile, glass and powder textures.
Composition/framing: a single landscape 3:2 photograph; objects grouped centrally with open margins suitable for cover crops. Every object rests naturally on a tabletop or vanity.
Lighting/mood: soft natural window light and subtle shadows, calm elegant beauty studio atmosphere.
Color palette: coordinated warm cream, blush pink and refined burgundy accents.
Constraints: objects only. No people, faces, hands, body parts, mannequins, portraits, reflected people, skin swatches, text, labels, brands, logos, watermarks or collages. All tools, packaging and containers are unbranded and unlabelled.
Primary request: elegant bridal beauty preparation still life.
Scene/backdrop: softly lit warm cream vanity.
Subject: a draped burgundy embroidered dupatta, refined gold earrings and bangles, three elegant bridal makeup brushes, berry lipstick and a plain makeup compact. Arrange fabric, jewelry and cosmetics in one cohesive central composition. Show delicate embroidered threads, gentle fabric folds and realistic brushed gold surfaces. No mirrors or reflected people.
